flags.title: Kalshi event contracts: tax characterization (Section 1256 vs. ordinary capital gains) is unsettled
flags.why: No IRS revenue ruling, regulation, or notice classifies CFTC-DCM event contracts. In 2026 the federal appeals courts split on whether they are CEA 'swaps' (3d Cir. favored CFTC exclusivity in April 2026; 9th Cir. [Aug 28, 2026] and 6th Cir. [Sep 25, 2026] held otherwise), and further review is possible. Any '60/40' claim you see elsewhere is a position, not a rule.
flags.impact: Affects your tax RATE and forms (6781 vs 8949), not whether the income counts for Medi-Cal/Marketplace (net gains are in AGI either way). Net LOSS years still matter for MAGI via the $3,000 offset rule.
flags.action: Ask a CPA to paper a position; monitor IRS guidance and SCOTUS docket.

flags.title: 2027 Medi-Cal work requirement: whether NON-wage income (rent/interest/trading) satisfies the $580/month alternative
flags.why: The CMS interim-final-rule fact sheet words the alternative as 'monthly income that is not less than the federal minimum wage multiplied by 80 hours' ($580 in 2026) without a verified definition of 'income' on this page. If MAGI-basis income qualifies, your rent/interest could satisfy the rule with no work at all; if only earned income counts, it may not.
flags.impact: Potentially decisive for your plan if you rely on Medi-Cal in 2027+.
flags.action: Get a written county/DHCS answer; watch DHCS MEDIL/ACWDL letters implementing the rule for California.

flags.title: Whether full-time trading counts as 80 hours of 'work' for the 2027 Medicaid requirement
flags.why: CMS lists employment, work programs, community service and education. Self-directed trading is not expressly addressed in the verified sources; 'work' for Medicaid purposes has historically centered on employment/self-employment — trading gains are investment activity (no SE tax), which cuts both ways.
flags.impact: Don't build a compliance plan on trading-hours documentation alone.
flags.action: Confirm with DHCS/county before relying on it; consider half-time education enrollment or volunteer hours as documented fallbacks.

flags.title: California exempt-surcharge amounts for tax year 2026 not yet published
flags.why: FTB's published page reviewed on 2026-10-18 gives TY2025 figures ($950/$475; 7.28% affordability threshold). The TY2026 indexed amounts appear when FTB updates for filing season 2027. Left blank rather than projected.
flags.impact: Minor — you likely avoid any penalty by having MEC all year.
flags.action: Re-check ftb.ca.gov health-care-mandate page in early 2027.

flags.title: Real-estate-professional / active-participation eligibility is fact-specific for you
flags.why: Being employed as a property manager does not automatically make you a 'real estate professional' for your OWN rentals (IRS tests involve >50% of personal services and >750 hours in real property trades/businesses in which you materially participate), and the $25,000 special allowance needs ownership plus active participation with MAGI ≤ ~$150,000. Rules verified; YOUR facts were not.
flags.impact: Determines whether rental losses can offset trading gains to reduce MAGI.
flags.action: Have a CPA test your hours/ownership facts against Pub 527 / Pub 925 before planning.

flags.title: TY2026 0%-capital-gains bracket thresholds
flags.why: IRS Topic 409 (reviewed 2026-10-18) published TY2025 thresholds ($48,350 single). The identical 2026 bracket tables were not re-fetched in this session, so the 2026 numbers are left blank.
flags.impact: Only relevant to your tax bill, not eligibility.
flags.action: Check Rev. Proc. 2025-32 tables on irs.gov when preparing the 2026 return.

flags.title: Covered CA 2027 rates and carrier availability are preliminary
flags.why: The 9.9% weighted-average increase announced July 21, 2026 is a PROPOSED rate subject to Department of Health Care Review; Molina Healthcare is leaving parts of LA/Orange counties in 2027. Plan availability and premiums in your ZIP code must be confirmed in Shop & Compare.
flags.impact: Your actual 2027 premium numbers depend on final rates and your ZIP.
flags.action: Re-run Shop & Compare after Nov 1, 2026 enrollment launch.

flags.title: County-only coverage programs not verified
flags.why: Some counties run supplemental safety-net programs (e.g., LA County's My Health LA). Statewide verification of eligibility and current status was outside this session's scope; no county programs are asserted on the tables.
flags.impact: You may have additional local options.
flags.action: Tell us your California county to add a verified county-program section.

flags.title: Medi-Cal for ages 60–69: not fully verified
flags.why: DHCS eligibility letters reference the adult 19–64 expansion group; California separately covers low-income 60–69-year-olds (2022 Older Adult Expansion; share-of-cost elimination for 65+), but the exact 2026 rule for a 60–69-year-old with investment income was not re-verified line-by-line, so MED-10 remains flagged.
flags.action: Confirm via county office if applicable.

flags.title: Covered CA's "$10/month" and "$0 premium" claims are averages, not guarantees
flags.why: Covered CA states some plans 'cost as little as $10 per month' and that ~200,000 consumers can pick $0-premium Silver plans in 2027. Actual premiums are age-, region- and plan-specific; they were not individually re-verified for any ZIP code.
flags.impact: Use the official quote tool for your ZIP rather than the headline number.
